'''Brutann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Beast-Lord]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and a Sith serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Brutann was serving as a secret weapon of the Sith Empire, controlling local predators to attack [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] expeditions. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Heljus]] perished in one of such attacks, but lived long enough to ask a Republic hero for help. This Republic hero tracked and killed Brutann and many of his creatures.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] storyline, it is revealed that Brutann was originally from Onderon, and was from a group of people known as the [[Untamed]]. He was siblings with the Beast-Lord [[Akoru]].<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> According to [[Darth Savik]], his master served [[Darth Jadus]] before the latter's disappearance.
